title: Pitch Deck March Madness
summary: Study 16 startup pitch deck examples and presentations, including Airbnb, LinkedIn, Coinbase, and Peloton, with format labels and a practical study worksheet.
body_markdown:
Startup pitch deck examples can help you see how different companies explain a problem, a product, and an opportunity. This collection brings together 16 historical decks, presentations, a memo, and a recorded pitch, including Airbnb, LinkedIn, Coinbase, and Peloton. Use them to sharpen your own story, not to copy somebody else's numbers.


The collection began as Finta's 2024 Pitch Deck March Madness feature. It is now an evergreen study library, not an active competition or promotion. We identify the format of each resource because a seed deck, an investor memo, and a product presentation do different jobs.


## Choose an example that fits the question you are working on


Most slide resources are historical copies hosted on SlideShare by the named uploaders, not authenticated originals published on the company's current website. LinkedIn also has a founder's annotated account, and DoorDash is a Demo Day video. Historical market figures and traction describe the period of the material, not the company's current performance.


Company Resource format Study focus


Airbnb Historical pitch deck, SlideShare copy Explain a marketplace simply


Tinder Historical pitch deck, SlideShare copy Communicate a product experience

## A pitch deck study worksheet


Choose two or three relevant examples, then answer these questions in your own working document. This worksheet is Finta's editorial framework, not a claim that a particular deck caused a successful fundraise.


1. **Audience:** Who is the presentation for, and what decision does it seek?
2. **Opening:** When do you understand the customer, problem, and proposed solution?
3. **Evidence:** Which claims are supported, which are assumptions, and what would you ask to verify?
4. **Order:** Why does one idea come before another? Does that order fit your company?
5. **Economics:** Can you distinguish market opportunity, business model, historical results, and forecasts?
6. **Transfer:** What communication choice could improve your deck without borrowing the example's facts?


For a slide-by-slide planning framework, use our[guide to creating a pitch deck](https://finta.ai/blog/creating-compelling-pitch-decks-templates-examples-and-expert-insights) . For the narrative itself, read the[pitch deck storytelling guide](https://finta.ai/blog/pitch-deck-mastery-persuasive-storytelling-for-startup-fundraising) .


## Airbnb pitch deck


Ask how the opening connects the traveler's problem to a marketplace solution. Which part of your own customer experience could become just as easy to picture?


**[Airbnb Pitch Deck From 2008](https://www.slideshare.net/slideshow/airbnb-pitch-deck-from-2008/65585661)** from **[Ryan Gum](https://www.slideshare.net/ryangum)**


## Tinder pitch deck


Look for the moment the reader understands the product. What would a first-time user need to see before your own feature list becomes meaningful?


**[Tinder Pitch Deck](https://www.slideshare.net/slideshow/tinder-pitch-deck/69837113)** from **[Ryan Gum](https://www.slideshare.net/ryangum)**


## Brex pitch deck


Use the deck to question your own customer definition. Can a reader tell who buys, why the existing alternative is frustrating, and where the business starts?


**[Brex Pitch Deck](https://www.slideshare.net/slideshow/brex-pitch-deck/234337901)** von **[Pitch Decks](https://www.slideshare.net/BaseTemplates)**


## LinkedIn pitch deck


Compare the presentation with Reid Hoffman's explanation of its context. Which investor concern determines the order of your own story?


Read[Reid Hoffman's annotated pitch to Greylock](https://www.reidhoffman.org/linkedin-pitch-to-greylock/) for a first-person explanation of the audience and reasoning behind this Series B presentation.


**[Linkedin Series B Pitch Deck](https://www.slideshare.net/slideshow/linkedin-deck-27367069/27367069)** from **[Joseph Hsieh](https://www.slideshare.net/webjoe)**


## Tesla presentation


This is an investor presentation centered on Model S, not a universal early-stage template. Ask when product detail helps the argument and when it belongs in an appendix.


**[Tesla Investor Presentation - Model S](https://www.slideshare.net/startuphome/tesla-investor-presentation-model-s)** from **[startuphome](https://www.slideshare.net/startuphome)**


## Rippling investor memo


A memo can explain an argument differently from slides. Compare the depth of a written case with the shorter points you would need for a live investor conversation.


**[Rippling Pitch Deck & Investor Memo](https://www.slideshare.net/slideshow/rippling-investor-memo/140271471)** from **[Matt Epstein](https://www.slideshare.net/MattEpstein5)**


## DoorDash recorded pitch


This resource is a recorded pitch rather than a downloadable deck. Ask what the speaker can explain aloud that would need more context in a send-ahead presentation.


[Watch DoorDash at YC Summer 2013 Demo Day](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YNAOXokK--o) .


## Blueground presentation


This event presentation is not labeled here as a verified fundraising deck. Consider how to explain the customer problem and service to people unfamiliar with your category.


**[Blueground at Open Coffee Athens XC](https://www.slideshare.net/slideshow/blueground-at-open-coffee-athens-xc/85666887)** from **[Open Coffee Greece](https://www.slideshare.net/opencoffeegr)**


## YouTube pitch deck


Ask which parts of your product require explanation and which can be demonstrated. A recognizable use case can give the audience an entry point into an unfamiliar category.


**[YouTube Pitch Deck](https://www.slideshare.net/slideshow/youtube-pitch-deck-87211646/87211646)** from **[startuphome](https://www.slideshare.net/startuphome)**


## Uber pitch deck


Use the presentation as a prompt to map the customer's experience before and after your product. Keep the comparison grounded in the problem your company actually solves.


**[Uber pitch deck](https://www.slideshare.net/kambosu/uber-pitch-deck)** de **[Donatella Cambosu](https://www.slideshare.net/kambosu)**


## Facebook pitch deck


Ask who the presentation is speaking to and what it wants that audience to believe. Do not assume a deck labeled with a famous company fits your round or customer.


**[Facebook Pitch Deck](https://www.slideshare.net/slideshow/facebook-pitch-deck-87761364/87761364)** from **[startuphome](https://www.slideshare.net/startuphome)**


## Gusto / ZenPayroll pitch deck


The source uses the earlier ZenPayroll name. Study how you could explain the buyer's existing process before asking an investor to understand your proposed product.


**[Zenpayroll Pitch Deck Template](https://www.slideshare.net/slideshow/zenpayroll-startup-deck-template/25971567)** from **[Joseph Hsieh](https://www.slideshare.net/webjoe)**


## Coinbase pitch deck


Separate explanation of the category from explanation of the company. Which concept would your reader need to understand before they can evaluate your business?


**[Coinbase Seed Round Pitch Deck](https://www.slideshare.net/slideshow/coinbase-seed-round-pitch-deck/78867044)** from **[Brian Armstrong](https://www.slideshare.net/BrianArmstrong29)**


## Snapchat presentation


This is labeled as a business presentation, not an authenticated original seed deck. Ask how the narrative would change for a customer, advertiser, or prospective investor.


**[235629204 snapchat-business-deck](https://www.slideshare.net/slideshow/235629204-snapchatbusinessdeck/38594605)** from **[Yan Rozovsky](https://www.slideshare.net/Calimen)**


## BuzzFeed pitch deck


Use the example to examine your own relationship between audience, distribution, and the business model. A large audience number is more useful when the reader understands its role.


**[BuzzFeed Pitch Deck](https://www.slideshare.net/slideshow/buzzfeed-pitch-deck/66715392)** von **[Tech in Asia ID](https://www.slideshare.net/TechInAsiaID)**


## Peloton pitch deck


Use the deck as a prompt to explain the customer's experience and the business around it. The verified SlideShare copy gives an additional way to view the historical presentation.


[View the Peloton pitch deck on SlideShare](https://www.slideshare.net/slideshow/peleton-pitch-deck/234417272) . The title-slide image below is retained from the original collection.


Full Pitch Deck:[https://www.slideshare.net/slideshow/peleton-pitch-deck/234417272](https://www.slideshare.net/slideshow/peleton-pitch-deck/234417272)


## Turn the examples into your own next draft


Pick one useful communication principle from the collection, revise the relevant part of your deck, and ask a teammate to read it without your explanation. The question is not “Does this look like Airbnb?” It is “Can this person understand our business and tell us what they still need to know?”


Give Aurora the approved draft and your notes from the worksheet. Ask for unclear claims, missing evidence, and likely questions. Keep your company's actual metrics and source material as the authority; an AI review should not invent the proof.


> Review this deck using the study worksheet. Use only our supplied facts. Identify where the audience may lose the thread, which claims need evidence, and what belongs in an appendix. Return a short revision list. Do not copy another company's numbers or imply their fundraising result applies to us.


Keep the approved deck, investor questions, and next actions connected in[Finta CRM](https://finta.ai/product/crm) . Our[pitch deck analytics guide](https://finta.ai/blog/pitch-deck-tracking) and[investor follow-up workflow](https://finta.ai/workflows/follow-up) help with the work after sharing.


Collection and format labels reviewed October 3, 2026. External resources remain hosted by their respective publishers or uploaders and may require their own access. This is a study collection, not an active contest, a claim of endorsement, or evidence that a deck alone caused funding.
